text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.N. Special Commission confirms Iraq has dug up four destroyed missile engines.
- Iraqi foreign minister complains to the U.N. secretary- general of the Iranian rejection to hand to Iraq those responsible for shooting and wounding President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday.
- Director-general of the Iraqi Airways says Iran impedes Iraq's efforts to know the fate of five Iraqi airliners sent to Iran during the 1991 Gulf War to escape bombings.
